current_concerns.primary_problems: Restrictive eating since age 18, ongoing calorie counting, preoccupation with body shape, avoidance of eating with others, and significant daily time occupied by food-related concerns.
current_concerns.goals: Eat a meal with friends without planning for days beforehand and stop planning the whole day around food.

past_psychiatric_history.assessment_details: Assessed in 2021 by an eating disorders service for restrictive eating.
past_psychiatric_history.hospital_details: Admitted to Toronto General Hospital in 2021 for medical stabilisation; hospitalized for about two weeks.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Family-based treatment in 2021, approximately 20 sessions through an eating disorders programme; cognitive behavioural therapy for eating disorders in 2023, approximately 20 sessions at an outpatient clinic.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Mother has anxiety and has had therapy for it.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Research assistant at the University of Toronto since 2024.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born and raised in Toronto; described herself as a perfectionistic child.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: High achieving; eating difficulties began in the final year of school and continued thereafter.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Single; lives with two housemates; close to her mother, who is a major source of support.
personal_history.future_goals: Finish a master’s degree and stop planning the day around food.
